main_text.p: gerwida, paravi.: gegertwef, præpara-bitur] Vide supra Garo.
Gelpurt Dos, Investigasti] Investiga-re, Sax. berpÿnian.; vestigium ꝓpon. Teuton. hodie, Investigatio gbelpoze. Kilian. [illegible, ~8 letters]

Getimbzlt, Ædificabitur] Ædifica-re, Sax. ꝝetumbhian, Belg. timmeren, German. stimmeren: unde nostratium timber. Belg. timmerbont, German. zimmer, i.e. tignum, lignum, voce autem Latino-barbarâ, mærenhium, de quâ D. Watsius in Glossar.

Getrimbetos, Fabricatus] Formare, imò & stabilire, Sax. ꝝetumman: à priori, nostrum trim, E. G. trith and trim, i.e. elegans & perpolitus; qualis qui sub manibus barbitonsoris fuerit, cujus opificium, nobis trimming dictum. Plura videinfrà in Sanctreft.
Gefocon, Adjiciam: supra gefuogan] Vide Geoto on supra.
Getweigit, Vexatus] Sax. pap, nobis hodie woh, dolor, huic verbo inest, ut mihi persuasum.
Gebinsos, Visitas] Sax. visitare ze-neoran? Gtoolot,

page.notes: Marginal and interlinear fragments are faint; several Old English glosses are uncertain and marked by reading only. Show-through from the reverse page appears in the lower half and was omitted.
